> ⚠️ **This form will be public.** A real vulnerability must be reported
> through the channel in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) (private GitHub
> advisory preferred, or email to the owner). This form is only useful
> for: a security-related **doc bug**, a request to **expand in-scope
> items**, or a **question** about the threat model.

## Category

- [ ] Doc / threat-model gap
- [ ] In-scope list request
- [ ] Other:

## Details
